Theme

Latin word

plūs

plūs, plūris n. + gen.

neuter noun, used in the nominative and accusative, with the thing in the genitive, declension

more of a thing you measure: more food, more time, more milk; more (with verbs: love more, be worth more)

In this lexicon

  • more

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 66: eō plūs viāticī quaerere; Traupman 347

  • more

    also used · classical · Catull. 14.1: nī tē plūs oculīs meīs amārem; Cic. Q. fr. 3.1.7: plūs ut illum amēs quam ipse amō

  • plūs minus: less

    classical

    Give me more milk.composed
